title: Runs on a truncated input
statement: Let $M$ be a nondeterministic multi-tape Turing machine over an alphabet $\Gamma$ with state set $S$, let $x$ be an input word, and let $m$ be a natural number. For any Boolean choice word $w$ with $|w|\le m$, the run from the initial configuration on $x$ and the run from the initial configuration on the prefix of $x$ of length $m$ have equal states, input-head positions, work-tape contents, work-tape head positions, and outputs.
hypotheses_covered: A nondeterministic machine with $k$ work tapes, alphabet $\Gamma$, and state set $S$.
A Boolean choice word $w$ with $|w|\le m$.
